D001:2.en: I have my first paid job next Monday, but I still don’t have the business number sorted out. I’m worried I won’t know what details to put on the paperwork.
D001:2.yue: 我下星期一就有第一單收錢嘅工作，但澳洲商業號碼仲未搞掂。我最驚到時張單唔知應該寫咩資料。

D001:4.en: The form says I plan to start trading on 1 September. I filled that in a while ago. Is that date still okay, or should I change it before I submit?
D001:4.yue: 份表我寫咗九月一號開始做生意，嗰陣填落去㗎。依家個日期仲用得，定係交之前要改返？

D001:6.en: I’ve got my photo identification and tax details ready. One document is only on my phone. Is a clear electronic copy enough, or do you need the original?
D001:6.yue: 有相身份證明同稅務資料我都齊，淨係有一份文件喺手機入面。清楚嘅電子副本得唔得，定一定要正本？

D001:8.en: If something changes while the application is being checked, should I update the existing application straight away, or wait until someone contacts me?
D001:8.yue: 我就怕等緊嗰陣資料有變。真係改咗嘅話，我係即刻喺原本嗰份申請度更新，定等你哋搵我先？

D001:10.en: If the Australian Business Number has not been approved when I finish my first job, should I wait before issuing the invoice, or can I send it later once the number is confirmed?
D001:10.yue: 如果我做完第一單工作嗰陣澳洲商業號碼仲未批，我張單係咪應該遲啲先開，等個號碼確認咗再寄畀客人？

D001:12.en: Okay, I’ll check it again tonight.

D002:2.en: I received a message today saying my proposed business name still needs to be dealt with. I’m not sure whether that means the name is already reserved or not yet registered.
D002:2.yue: 今日收到通知，話我申請嗰個商業名稱仲要處理。我搞唔清楚：即係個名已經留咗畀我，定其實仲未正式註冊？

D002:4.en: The name I applied for is Harbour Home Repairs. I need to print signs before the end of the month. Can I rely on that name yet?
D002:4.yue: 我申請嗰個名係「海港家居維修」。月底前我要整招牌，依家可唔可以當個名已經用得㗎？

D002:6.en: I have the Australian Business Number details and my contact address. Which information do you actually need for the business-name application?
D002:6.yue: 澳洲商業號碼資料同聯絡地址我都有。申請商業名稱嗰邊實際要我交邊幾樣資料呀？

D002:8.en: Most of it is here. The only thing I still need to find is the copy of the lease showing the business address.
D002:8.yue: 大部分都喺手邊，淨係證明營業地址嗰份租約副本仲未搵返。

D002:10.en: Once I submit that, should I keep using my legal personal name on invoices until the business name is formally registered?
D002:10.yue: 咁我補交之後，未正式註冊好之前，開單係咪照用我自己個法定姓名先？

D002:12.en: If the name is rejected because it is too similar to another one, will the written notice tell me what I need to change?
D002:12.yue: 如果因為個名同人哋太似而唔批，封書面通知會唔會講清楚我係邊度要改？

D002:13.en: Until the business name is formally registered, keep using the legal entity name on official records. If the proposed name is refused, the notice will explain the next available step.
D002:13.yue: 商業名稱未正式註冊之前，正式紀錄先用返法定實體名稱。如果申請唔獲批准，通知會交代之後可以點處理。

D002:14.en: Got it. I’ll hold off on printing the signs, use my legal name on the paperwork for now, and wait for the written confirmation.
D002:14.yue: 明白。咁我住先唔印招牌，文件照用法定姓名，等收到正式確認先再改。

D003:2.en: My forecast says the business could turn over about $78,000 this year. I’m not sure whether that figure means I already need to register for goods and services tax.
D003:2.yue: 我估今年營業額大概七萬八千蚊，但我唔知去到呢個數係咪即係已經要登記商品及服務稅。

D003:3.en: The key figure is your business turnover, not your profit. We need to check what sales are included in the turnover calculation and whether the registration threshold is met.
D003:3.yue: 最主要係睇生意營業額，唔係淨利潤。我哋要先分清楚邊啲銷售要計入去，再睇有冇去到登記門檻。

D003:4.en: Some of that forecast is only work I might get later in the year. Does expected work count the same way as sales I’ve already made?
D003:4.yue: 嗰七萬八入面有一部分只係估下半年可能接到嘅工作。未做成嘅生意，都係咁樣計落營業額度㗎？

D003:6.en: I can show you my sales records and the bookings I’ve already accepted. Is that enough to work out the position, or do you also need my expense records?
D003:6.yue: 銷售紀錄同已經接咗嘅訂單我都有。要計清楚依家個情況，呢啲夠未，定連開支紀錄都要睇埋？

D003:8.en: The sales records are ready. I’m missing one bank statement, but I can download it tonight.
D003:8.yue: 銷售紀錄齊晒，淨係少一張銀行月結單。我今晚返去可以下載返。

D003:10.en: When I send the records, I want proof of the date they were received. What should I keep in case the deadline is questioned later?
D003:10.yue: 交資料嗰陣我想留到收件日期嘅證明。萬一之後有人話我遲咗，我應該保存邊樣嘢最穩陣？

D003:12.en: If I’m still waiting after I’ve sent everything, I should follow up on the same registration rather than lodge another one, right?
D003:12.yue: 如果交齊之後仲等緊，我應該跟返原本嗰宗登記，唔係重新整多一份，係咪？

D003:13.en: Correct. Keep the original submission reference and follow up on that record. A duplicate registration can make the history harder to reconcile.
D003:13.yue: 啱。留住原本嘅提交參考編號，之後跟返嗰份紀錄。重複登記反而會令前後資料更難核對。

D003:14.en: All right. I’ll download the missing statement tonight and keep everything under the one registration record.
D003:14.yue: 好，我今晚補返嗰張月結單，之後所有資料都跟同一份登記紀錄處理。

D004:2.en: The invoice total is $1,650 and it includes goods and services tax. I can see the total, but I’m not sure what has to be shown separately on the invoice.
D004:2.yue: 張單總數係一千六百五十蚊，入面包咗商品及服務稅。總數我睇到，但究竟張單要分開列明啲咩，我就唔清楚。

D004:3.en: A valid tax invoice needs the required seller and transaction details, and the tax component must be shown in the form required for that type of sale. Let’s check what is missing from yours.
D004:3.yue: 合規格嘅稅務發票要有賣方同交易資料，稅項亦要按嗰類交易嘅要求列明。我哋逐樣睇下你張單欠咗邊項。

D004:4.en: The customer wants the invoice before the next payment date. If I correct it today, can I send the replacement without cancelling the whole sale?
D004:4.yue: 個客想喺下一次付款日前收到張單。如果我今日改好，係咪直接寄返張更正版就得，唔使成宗交易取消再嚟過？

D004:6.en: Yes, $1,650 is still the correct total. The older draft is the one with the wrong date.
D004:6.yue: 係，一千六百五十蚊個總數冇變。錯嘅係之前嗰個草稿日期。

D004:7.en: Then correct the date and make sure the final invoice contains the required business and tax details. Keep the earlier draft so you can explain what changed if necessary.
D004:7.yue: 咁就改返個日期，再核對正式發票上面嘅商業同稅務資料齊唔齊。舊草稿都留住，有需要時可以交代改過咩。

D004:8.en: I’ve got the sales record and the business-number details. Should I attach the old draft too, or just keep it in my own records?
D004:8.yue: 銷售紀錄同澳洲商業號碼資料我都有。舊嗰張草稿要唔要一齊交，定我自己留底就得？

D004:10.en: I have the final sales record with me. The old draft is on my computer at home.
D004:10.yue: 正式銷售紀錄喺度，舊草稿就喺屋企部電腦入面。

D004:12.en: If the customer has already paid part of the amount, does correcting the invoice change when the remaining balance is due?
D004:12.yue: 如果個客已經畀咗一部分錢，依家更正張單會唔會連餘款幾時到期都受影響？

D004:14.en: If the written decision or advice later says the invoice was still wrong, can I ask exactly which required detail was missing?
D004:14.yue: 如果之後書面回覆都話張單有問題，我可唔可以要求佢哋講明究竟欠咗邊一項必要資料？

D004:15.en: Yes. Ask for the specific defect to be identified. If an issued invoice needs correction, keep a clear record linking the corrected document to the original transaction.
D004:15.yue: 可以，要求對方指出具體邊度唔啱。如果已經發出嘅發票要更正，就要留清楚紀錄，睇得出更正版同原本交易係同一宗。

D004:16.en: That’s clear. I’ll correct the date, keep the old draft, and make sure the customer can see which invoice is the final version.
D004:16.yue: 清楚喇。我會改返日期，舊草稿留底，亦會畀個客一眼睇得出邊張先係最後版本。

D005:2.en: The quarter ended on 30 June. I’ve entered the sales and expenses, but I’m worried I’ve missed something before I lodge the activity statement.
D005:2.yue: 個季度六月三十號完咗。收入同開支我已經入晒，但臨交商業活動報表之前，我仲係驚自己漏咗嘢。

D005:4.en: I’ve checked the figures twice. The part I’m unsure about is one expense receipt that arrived after the quarter ended. Should it be included now?
D005:4.yue: 啲數我對過兩次，係有張開支收據過咗季度先收到，我唔知應該今次計埋，定留返下一期。

D005:6.en: I have the sales records, tax records and expense receipts together. If I lodge online today, will the system give me a dated confirmation?
D005:6.yue: 銷售、稅務同開支收據我都執埋一齊。今日網上交嘅話，系統會唔會畀返一個有日期嘅確認紀錄？

D005:8.en: After I lodge it, should I check the online status first rather than call straight away?
D005:8.yue: 交完之後，我係咪先上網睇處理狀況，唔使即刻打電話去問？

D005:9.en: Yes. First make sure the lodgment shows as received and keep the receipt. If the status does not change as expected, use the existing lodgment reference when you follow up.
D005:9.yue: 係，首先確認系統顯示已經收到，收據亦要留低。如果之後個狀況一直冇照預期更新，跟進嗰陣用返原本嘅提交編號。

D005:10.en: What if I discover tomorrow that I left out one expense receipt? I don’t want to lodge the whole statement a second time by mistake.
D005:10.yue: 如果聽日先發現漏咗一張開支收據點算？我唔想一時心急又成份報表交多次。

D005:11.en: Don’t lodge a duplicate statement just to fix one item. Check the amendment process for the period and keep the document that explains the correction.
D005:11.yue: 唔好為咗改一項就重複交成份報表。睇返嗰個季度要用咩更正程序，亦要留住證明點解要改嘅文件。

D005:13.en: Exactly. Keep the original receipt, any amendment confirmation and the supporting records together so the sequence is clear later.
D005:13.yue: 啱。原本收據、更正確認同相關紀錄放埋一齊，之後翻查就睇得出前後次序。

D005:14.en: Good. I’ll file the confirmation with this quarter’s records and check the status before I do anything else.
D005:14.yue: 好，我會將確認紀錄同今季啲文件放埋一齊，之後先睇處理狀況，再決定使唔使跟進。

D006:2.en: I’m changing from a sole trader to a company at the end of this month. I’m worried I’ll mix the old and new records when customers start paying the company.
D006:2.yue: 我月底會由獨資轉做公司，最驚係客人開始畀錢間公司嗰陣，我將新舊兩套紀錄撈亂晒。

D006:4.en: The company is supposed to start on 1 October. That date was chosen months ago. Can you check whether the record still shows 1 October?
D006:4.yue: 公司原本定咗十月一號開始，個日期幾個月前填落去㗎。你可唔可以幫我睇下紀錄依家仲係咪十月一號？

D006:6.en: The company registration and banking details are ready. One certificate is only electronic. Is a clear copy acceptable for the update?
D006:6.yue: 公司註冊同銀行資料都齊，有張證明淨係得電子版本。更新資料嗰陣交清楚副本得唔得？

D006:8.en: If the start date changes by a few days, should I update the existing record before the company begins trading?
D006:8.yue: 如果最後開業日差咗幾日，我係咪應該喺公司正式做生意之前改返原本嗰份紀錄？

D006:10.en: Some customers have already placed orders under my sole-trader name. From the changeover date, how should I keep those jobs separate from new company work?
D006:10.yue: 有幾個客已經用我獨資嗰個名落咗單。去到轉公司嗰日，新公司啲生意同之前啲單應該點樣分開記先清楚？

D006:12.en: Thanks. I’ll separate the records by the changeover date and keep the registration confirmation with the company documents.
D006:12.yue: 唔該。我會用轉公司嗰日做界線，將新舊紀錄分開，確認文件就放入公司嗰套資料度。

D006:13.en: That will make the history easier to follow. Keep records showing which legal entity handled each transaction before and after the change.
D006:13.yue: 咁樣之後會容易追返。轉換前後每宗交易係由邊個法定實體處理，都留返清楚紀錄。

D007:2.en: The notice mentions a temporary food-stall permit. I’ve only sold packaged food before, so I’m not sure what extra approval a cooked-food stall needs.
D007:2.yue: 封通知講到臨時食品攤位許可。我以前淨係賣包裝食品，依家想即場整熟食，就唔清楚仲要批啲咩。

D007:4.en: My first market is on 12 September. If the permit is not ready by then, I assume I cannot just turn up and start selling, right?
D007:4.yue: 我第一個市集係九月十二號。如果到時個許可仲未批，我應該唔可以照去開檔賣嘢，係咪？

D007:6.en: I have the public-liability insurance and the food-safety certificate. Do you need both now, or is one of them only for the market organiser?
D007:6.yue: 公眾責任保險同食物安全證明我都有。兩樣都要依家交畀你哋，定其中一份其實係畀市集主辦方睇？

D007:8.en: The insurance document is here. I still need the updated food-safety certificate from the course provider.
D007:8.yue: 保險文件喺手，更新咗嗰張食物安全證明就仲等緊課程機構寄畀我。

D007:10.en: While I’m waiting, can I still book the stall space, as long as I don’t sell food until the permit is approved?
D007:10.yue: 等緊期間，我可唔可以照預留個攤位位，只要許可未批之前唔正式賣食品就得？

D007:12.en: If they refuse it because one document is missing, will the notice say whether I can provide that document instead of making a completely new application?
D007:12.yue: 如果因為少一份文件而唔批，通知會唔會講我補返嗰份就得，定一定要成份重新申請？

D007:13.en: Check the refusal notice carefully. It should tell you what decision was made and what options are available. Do not trade until every required approval for that market is in place.
D007:13.yue: 收到不獲批准嘅通知要睇清楚，入面會交代個決定同可以點處理。嗰個市集要求嘅許可未齊之前，唔好正式開檔。

D007:14.en: Understood. I won’t open the stall before it is approved.

D008:2.en: My first order with this supplier is worth $4,800. I can pay it, but I was hoping to have a credit account before the next order.
D008:2.yue: 我第一張訂單係四千八百蚊，今次我畀得起，不過就想下一張單之前開好賒帳戶口。

D008:3.en: The supplier is assessing whether to offer you credit terms. They need enough information to judge the business’s payment capacity and trade history.
D008:3.yue: 供應商依家係評估畀唔畀賒數安排，要有足夠資料先睇到你間生意嘅付款能力同交易紀錄。

D008:4.en: If the next order is due before the credit account is approved, do I pay that order normally and keep the credit application separate?
D008:4.yue: 如果下一張訂單到期嗰陣賒帳戶口仲未批，我係咪照平時方式畀嗰張單，賒帳申請就另外等？

D008:6.en: I have two business references and the bank details. Is that enough to begin the assessment, or do they also want recent statements?
D008:6.yue: 兩個商業推薦人同銀行資料我準備好咗。咁樣夠唔夠開始評估，定仲要最近嘅月結單？

D008:8.en: Most of the documents are here. One bank statement is at home, but I can send it this evening.
D008:8.yue: 大部分文件都喺度，有張銀行月結單留咗喺屋企，我今晚可以補返。

D008:10.en: After I submit the application, will I get a reference showing when it was received? That could matter if the payment terms are disputed later.
D008:10.yue: 交咗申請之後會唔會有個參考編號，睇到幾時收到？之後萬一大家對付款條件有爭議，個日期可能有用。

D008:12.en: If it takes longer than expected, I should ask about the existing application rather than send another one, correct?
D008:12.yue: 如果等得耐過預期，我應該問返原本嗰份申請去到邊，唔係再交多一份，係咪？

D008:14.en: All right. I’ll send the missing statement tonight and keep paying each order under the terms already agreed until the credit account is confirmed.
D008:14.yue: 好，我今晚補返嗰張月結單。賒帳戶口未正式批之前，每張訂單都照已經講好嘅付款條件做。

D008:15.en: That’s the safest approach. Keep each order’s payment terms and the credit-application correspondence so there is a clear record if anything is later disputed.
D008:15.yue: 咁樣最穩陣。每張訂單嘅付款條件同賒帳申請往來都留底，之後有爭議都容易對返。

D009:2.en: I paid $1,899 for the refrigerator and it stopped cooling after six weeks. The shop has offered another repair, but this would be the second one.
D009:2.yue: 部雪櫃買咗一千八百九十九蚊，用咗六個星期就唔凍。間舖頭話可以再整，但如果整就已經係第二次喇。

D009:3.en: Because it has already failed after a repair attempt, we need to look at the seriousness of the fault and what remedy is available under the consumer guarantees.
D009:3.yue: 既然整過之後又壞，就要睇個故障有幾嚴重，再按消費者保障去判斷可以要求咩補救。

D009:4.en: I need a working refrigerator before next Friday because my parents are coming to stay. Can I ask for a refund instead of waiting for another repair?
D009:4.yue: 下星期五我爸媽會嚟住，我一定要有部用得嘅雪櫃。咁我可唔可以唔再等佢整，直接要求退款？

D009:6.en: Yes, that service report is the latest one. The date on the first report was entered incorrectly.
D009:6.yue: 係，依家呢份先係最新維修報告。第一份嗰個日期當時入錯咗。

D009:7.en: Then provide both reports and point out the incorrect date so the retailer can see the repair history clearly. Keep the receipt and photographs as well.
D009:7.yue: 咁兩份報告都交，順便指出邊個日期寫錯，等商戶睇得清成個維修過程。收據同相片都一齊留住。

D009:8.en: I’ve got the receipt, photos and both service reports. Should I explain the wrong date in a short note so it doesn’t look like two different repairs?
D009:8.yue: 收據、相同兩份維修報告我都有。個日期寫錯嗰度，我係咪加句簡單說明，免得人哋以為係兩次唔同維修？

D009:10.en: Everything is ready except one photo that is still on my partner’s phone. I can add it tonight.
D009:10.yue: 其他都齊，淨係有張相仲喺我伴侶部手機度，今晚可以補返。

D009:12.en: While the shop is considering the complaint, should I keep the refrigerator as it is rather than arrange my own repair?
D009:12.yue: 間舖頭仲處理緊投訴嗰陣，我係咪住先保持部雪櫃原狀，唔好自己另外搵人整？

D009:13.en: Yes, keep the item and the evidence unless you have an agreed reason to do otherwise. An unauthorised repair can make it harder to establish the condition of the goods.
D009:13.yue: 係，除非雙方另外講好，否則貨品同證據住先留住。自己先搵人整，之後反而可能難證明當時件貨係咩狀況。

D009:14.en: If the shop still insists on another repair, can I ask them to explain in writing why they think that is the appropriate remedy?
D009:14.yue: 如果間舖頭仲堅持再整一次，我可唔可以叫佢哋書面講清楚，點解佢哋覺得維修先係合適補救？

D009:16.en: Thanks. I’ll keep the refrigerator and all the repair records, and I’ll ask for the retailer’s position in writing before deciding what to do next.
D009:16.yue: 唔該。我會留住部雪櫃同所有維修紀錄，先叫商戶書面交代佢哋立場，再決定下一步。

D010:2.en: I paid $16,500 for the car three weeks ago. Since then the engine warning light has come on twice, and I’ve already paid for one inspection.
D010:2.yue: 架車三個星期前買，一萬六千五百蚊。之後引擎警告燈着過兩次，我仲已經畀錢做咗一次檢查。

D010:4.en: I have the sale contract and the mechanic’s report. Is there anything else I should get from the dealer before the end of the month?
D010:4.yue: 買賣合約同車房檢查報告我都有。月底之前，我仲應該向車行攞多啲咩文件先？

D010:6.en: Can I send the contract and repair invoice electronically, or should I keep the originals and only send copies?
D010:6.yue: 合約同維修單據我可唔可以網上交副本？正本我想自己留住，唔想寄失。

D010:8.en: Once the dealer has my complaint and the mechanic’s report, how long should I give them to respond before I follow up?
D010:8.yue: 車行收到我份投訴同車房報告之後，我應該畀幾耐佢哋回覆，先至再追問會比較合理？

D010:10.en: If the warning light comes on again while I’m waiting, should I add that to the same complaint rather than start a new one?
D010:10.yue: 等緊嗰陣如果警告燈又着，我係咪補返落原本嗰宗投訴度，唔好另開一宗？

D010:12.en: Okay. I’ll keep all the records together.
